I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I told her I can't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co., because nothing she has access to mentions the account at all. I've kept the date as unverified, not as the renewal date. I suggested she confirm it in writing with the customer contact, or check it against the signed contract, before anyone plans around it.
